display-small.purpose: The one heading of each centered screen: start, progress, done, empty, error.

title-large.purpose: Side-sheet title and new-folder rename field, dialog title, app-bar wordmark.

title-medium.purpose: Source node name, node counts with tabular figures, the large button label.

title-small.purpose: Folder node names, the add-folder label, segmented-button labels.

body-large.purpose: Lead paragraph under a screen heading (44ch max) and the dialog text field.

body-medium.purpose: Base size: sheet rows, menu items, Settings rows, the trust line.

body-small.purpose: Hints, privacy note, bookmarks-bar label, supporting lines; node meta lines use the size without tracking.

label-medium.purpose: Menu headers and Settings group headings.

label-small.purpose: The New tag on proposed folders.

shadows.name: elev-1
shadows.purpose: Hover on filled buttons, folder nodes and the sheet's folder tile; the notice banner at rest.

shadows.name: elev-2
shadows.purpose: Menus and the emoji picker; the folder node under a dragged bookmark.

shadows.name: elev-3
shadows.purpose: The dialog; the side sheet when it overlays the board below 1024px.

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: Open node, over a 1px primary border.

shadows.name: drop-target
shadows.purpose: Folder node under the pointer during a drag, with a 10% teal wash.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every focusable element; offset -3px inside the segmented button.

shadows.name: favicon-ring
shadows.purpose: Cut-out ring separating overlapping favicons; --ring is the card color.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: State layers (150ms), progress width (250ms), indeterminate progress slide (1.4s loop).

motion.name: ease-emphasized
motion.purpose: Connector draw-in, side-sheet entrance, switch thumb.

motion.name: state-layer
motion.purpose: Hover and pressed overlays (8% and 12%), node border, background and shadow changes, connector color.

motion.name: connector-draw
motion.purpose: Connectors draw in once per proposal; the dashed Stays line fades in; redraws after edits or resizes are instant.

motion.name: sheet-enter
motion.purpose: Side sheet slides 24px in from the right while fading in.

motion.name: switch-thumb
motion.purpose: Thumb travels from 6px to 22px and grows from 16px to 24px.

motion.name: progress-indeterminate
motion.purpose: A 40% segment slides across the track.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Animations and transitions drop to 1ms; connectors appear drawn, the sheet appears in place; indeterminate progress becomes a static full bar at 40% opacity.

breakpoints.name: stacked
breakpoints.purpose: At and below: edge-to-edge workspace, single stacked column, no connectors or ports, style switch leaves the app bar, trust line on its own row.

breakpoints.name: sheet-overlay
breakpoints.purpose: At and below: the side sheet overlays the board under the app bar at min(400px, 100vw) with elev-3.

breakpoints.name: sheet-docked
breakpoints.purpose: From here up: the side sheet docks as a 400px column.

breakpoints.name: strip-hint
breakpoints.purpose: At and below: the bookmarks-bar hint is hidden.

breakpoints.name: dests-two-favicons
breakpoints.purpose: Destination column at or below: favicon preview drops from three to two.

breakpoints.name: dests-no-favicons
breakpoints.purpose: Destination column at or below: favicon preview disappears before names truncate.

components.name: Filled Button
components.description: The one primary action of a screen or dialog (Apply, Analyze, Finish, Create), with a leading 18px symbol and the change count on Apply.
components.css: .ds-btn-filled { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--primary, #006a62); color: var(--on-primary, #ffffff); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-filled svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-left: -8px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-filled::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: currentColor; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-filled:hover { box-shadow: var(--elev-1, 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)); } .ds-btn-filled:hover::before { opacity: 0.08; } .ds-btn-filled:active::before { opacity: 0.12; } .ds-btn-filled:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-filled:disabled { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-surface, #171d1c) 12%, transparent); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-surface, #171d1c) 38%, transparent); box-shadow: none; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-filled:disabled::before { opacity: 0; }

components.css: .ds-btn-tonal { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--secondary-container, #cce8e3); color: var(--on-secondary-container, #051f1c); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-tonal svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-left: -8px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-tonal::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: currentColor; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-tonal:hover::before { opacity: 0.08; } .ds-btn-tonal:active::before { opacity: 0.12; } .ds-btn-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-tonal:disabled { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-surface, #171d1c) 38%, transparent); cursor: default; } .ds-btn-tonal:disabled::before { opacity: 0; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Alternative actions beside a filled button, such as Undo on the done screen and the data actions in Settings.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--outline, #6f7977); border-radius: 20px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #006a62); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outlined svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-left: -8px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-outlined::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: currentColor; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-outlined:hover::before { opacity: 0.08; } .ds-btn-outlined:active::before { opacity: 0.12; } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outlined:disabled { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-surface, #171d1c) 38%, transparent); cursor: default; } .ds-btn-outlined:disabled::before { opacity: 0; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Low-emphasis actions: Reject all, Cancel, Don't create, Refresh.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #006a62); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-text::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: currentColor; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-text:hover::before { opacity: 0.08; } .ds-btn-text:active::before { opacity: 0.12; } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-text:disabled { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-surface, #171d1c) 38%, transparent); cursor: default; } .ds-btn-text:disabled::before { opacity: 0; }

components.name: App Bar
components.description: Sticky 64px bar on the page ground with the wordmark (the 32px app icon precedes it in the product), the folder-name segmented button on the review screen, and the settings icon button.
components.css: .ds-appbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 64px; padding: 0 16px 0 20px; background: var(--surface-low, #eff5f3); color: var(--on-surface, #171d1c); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-appbar-brand { font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.75rem; } .ds-appbar-spacer { flex: 1; } .ds-appbar-seg { display: inline-flex; height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--outline, #6f7977); border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-appbar-seg label { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--outline, #6f7977); color: var(--on-surface, #171d1c); font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-appbar-seg label:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-appbar-seg input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-appbar-seg svg { display: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-appbar-seg label:has(input:checked) { background: var(--secondary-container, #cce8e3); color: var(--on-secondary-container, #051f1c); } .ds-appbar-seg label:has(input:checked) svg { display: block; } .ds-appbar-seg label:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-appbar-icon { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: transparent; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #3f4947); cursor: pointer; } .ds-appbar-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-appbar-icon::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: currentColor; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-appbar-icon:hover::before { opacity: 0.08; } .ds-appbar-icon:active::before { opacity: 0.12; } .ds-appbar-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Text Field
components.description: The new-folder dialog field: 56px, 4px corners, 1px outline edge that thickens to 2px teal on focus without moving the text.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 312px; } .ds-field input { height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--outline, #6f7977); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--on-surface, #171d1c); font: 400 1rem/1.5rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); padding: 0 15px; }

components.name: Bookmarks-bar Chips
components.description: The strip above the canvas: a static folder chip, a bookmark chip with favicon and name, and a pressed icon-only chip. Favicons are stand-ins.
components.html: Bookmarks barTools
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--surface-high, #e3eae8); background: var(--surface-lowest, #ffffff); color: var(--on-surface, #171d1c); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-strip-label { color: var(--on-surface-variant, #3f4947); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex: none; height: 32px; max-width: 200px; padding: 0 12px 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #bec9c6); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--on-surface, #171d1c); font: inherit; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-chip svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; fill: currentColor; } .ds-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-surface, #171d1c) 8%, transparent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { padding: 0 7px; border-color: transparent; background: var(--surface-container, #e9efed); } .ds-chip-folder { cursor: default; } .ds-chip-folder:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-chip-fav { display: block; flex: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--outline-variant, #bec9c6); }

components.name: Folder Nodes
components.description: Destination cards during a drag: the open folder the bookmark came from (selection ring, unlit), the drop target under the pointer, folders that can take it (lit), To check (never a target), and the dashed add-folder slot. Favicons are stand-ins.
components.css: .ds-nodes { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 380px; padding: 16px 16px 16px 24px; background-color: var(--surface, #f5faf8); background-image: radial-gradient(var(--dot, #cdd7d4) 1px, transparent 1.2px); background-size: 20px 20px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-node { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 7px 16px 7px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #bec9c6); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--node, #ffffff); color: var(--on-surface, #171d1c); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), border-color 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-node:hover { box-shadow: var(--elev-1, 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)); } .ds-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-node[aria-expanded='true'] { border-color: var(--primary, #006a62); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--primary, #006a62); } .ds-node-lit { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #006a62) 55%, var(--outline-variant, #bec9c6)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #006a62) 4%, var(--node, #ffffff)); } .ds-node-drop { border-color: var(--primary, #006a62); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #006a62) 10%, var(--node, #ffffff)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--primary, #006a62), var(--elev-2, 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), 0 2px 6px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)); } .ds-node-tile { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--secondary-container, #cce8e3); color: var(--on-secondary-container, #051f1c); font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-node-tile svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-node-review .ds-node-tile { background: var(--tertiary-container, #ffdf9e); color: var(--on-tertiary-container, #261a00); } .ds-node-stay .ds-node-tile { background: var(--surface-high, #e3eae8); color: var(--on-surface-variant, #3f4947); } .ds-node-text { min-width: 0; } .ds-node-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-node-name > span:first-child { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-node-meta { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #3f4947); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; } .ds-node-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; flex: none; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--tertiary-container, #ffdf9e); color: var(--on-tertiary-container, #261a00); font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-node-favs { display: flex; } .ds-node-favs i { display: block; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--outline-variant, #bec9c6) 0 7.5px, var(--node, #ffffff) 8px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--node, #ffffff), 0 0 0 3px var(--outline-variant, #bec9c6); } .ds-node-favs i + i { margin-left: -8px; } .ds-node-count { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #3f4947); } .ds-node-port { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: -6px; width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-top: -5px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--outline, #6f7977); background: var(--node, #ffffff); transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-node-lit .ds-node-port, .ds-node-drop .ds-node-port { border-color: var(--primary, #006a62); background: var(--primary, #006a62); } .ds-node-add { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 7px 16px 7px 8px; border: 1px dashed var(--outline, #6f7977); border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #006a62); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-node-add .ds-node-tile { background: transparent; color: inherit; } .ds-node-add:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #006a62); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #006a62) 8%, transparent); } .ds-node-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Flow Connectors
components.description: The signature: curves from the source port to each folder port, stroke 1.5px plus 0.5px per bookmark (7.5px cap), teal when open, amber at 70% for To check, a 1.5px dashed line for Stays; drawn in once, instantly under reduced motion.

components.css: .ds-flow { position: relative; width: 560px; height: 300px; overflow: hidden; background-color: var(--surface, #f5faf8); background-image: radial-gradient(var(--dot, #cdd7d4) 1px, transparent 1.2px); background-size: 20px 20px; color: var(--on-surface, #171d1c); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-flow-wires { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 560px; } .ds-flow-tile { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--secondary-container, #cce8e3); color: var(--on-secondary-container, #051f1c); font-size: 1.375rem; } .ds-flow-dst-stay .ds-flow-tile { background: var(--surface-high, #e3eae8); color: var(--on-surface-variant, #3f4947); } .ds-flow-text { min-width: 0; } .ds-flow-name { display: flex; align-items: center; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-flow-count { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #3f4947); } .ds-flow-port { position: absolute; right: -6px; }

components.name: Docked Action Bar
components.description: The last row of the review board: the trust line on the left, Reject all and the filled Apply button with the change count on the right; wraps the trust line above the buttons when narrow.
components.css: .ds-actionbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 16px; padding: 12px 16px 12px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--surface-high, #e3eae8); background: var(--surface-container, #e9efed); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-actionbar-summary { flex: 1 1 240px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; margin: 0; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #3f4947); } .ds-actionbar-summary svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; fill: currentColor; } .ds-actionbar-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-left: auto; } .ds-actionbar-text, .ds-actionbar-apply { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font, 'Google Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-actionbar-text { padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #006a62); } .ds-actionbar-apply { padding: 0 24px; background: var(--primary, #006a62); color: var(--on-primary, #ffffff); } .ds-actionbar-apply svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-left: -8px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-actionbar-text::before, .ds-actionbar-apply::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: currentColor; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-actionbar-text:hover::before, .ds-actionbar-apply:hover::before { opacity: 0.08; } .ds-actionbar-text:active::before, .ds-actionbar-apply:active::before { opacity: 0.12; } .ds-actionbar-apply:hover { box-shadow: var(--elev-1, 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)); } .ds-actionbar-text:focus-visible, .ds-actionbar-apply:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #006a62); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Nidomark's screens read like the plan a mover draws before the truck arrives: every bookmark is shown on its way to a labelled folder, line weights say how much travels where, and nothing leaves its shelf until the user signs at the bottom of the page. The visual language is Google's Material 3 taken at face value (tonal color roles, Google Sans, Material Symbols Rounded, pill-shaped buttons, a three-step soft elevation scale), so the extension feels like part of Chrome rather than a guest in it, light or dark as the browser decides.

The personality is spent in one place, the review canvas: a single source card on a dotted floor, curves fanning out to a column of folder cards, each curve as heavy as the number of bookmarks it carries, drawn in once when the proposal arrives. Around it the chrome stays quiet at a comfortable Material density (40px controls, 56px folder cards, 64px sheet rows), with one teal for acting and choosing and one amber for whatever deserves a second look.

Reassurance is part of the visual system rather than a message: the toolbar docked under the canvas says that nothing has changed yet at every width, and the Apply button states how many changes it will make. Settings and the analysis progress screen follow the same tokens; they are recorded here from code and have no reference screenshots yet.
keyCharacteristics: Material 3 color roles with a light and a dark value each, switched by prefers-color-scheme.
Tonal layering builds the structure; shadows appear only as a response or for overlays.
One family, Google Sans, in two weights (400 and 500) on the Material type scale.
Pill buttons, 16px cards and nodes, 12px tiles, 8px chips.
A node canvas whose connector weight encodes bookmark counts.
Drag and drop with lit targets, always paired with a menu path.

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Teal says act, choose or focus; amber says look again (To check, New, caution). No other hue belongs to the interface: folder emoji and site favicons are content, not palette.

rules.name: The Raised Node Rule
rules.body: A node always sits one tonal step above the canvas: white over the mist floor in light, surface-high over the near-black floor in dark. Never fill a node with the canvas color, and never with surface-lowest in dark.

rules.name: The Seam and Edge Rule
rules.body: Seams between sections and between list rows are 1px surface-high. Stronger edges belong to objects: outline-variant around nodes and chips, outline around outlined controls, fields and the switch.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Regular (400) for reading and for headings, Medium (500) for names, counts and actions. Headings grow in size, not in weight.

rules.name: The Names Before Pictures Rule
rules.body: When the destinations column narrows, the favicon preview gives up room first: three icons, then two below a 400px column, then none below 340px. A folder name may truncate only after that.

rules.name: The Docked Toolbar Rule
rules.body: The apply toolbar is the last row of the board, never a bar floating over the canvas. Its trust line stays visible at every width, and the Apply button carries the change count.

rules.name: The Lift Is a Response Rule
rules.body: Nodes, list cards, the workspace and the docked sheet are flat at rest; a shadow appears because the pointer is there, a menu opened, a drop is possible, or a layer is modal.

rules.name: The Pill Is for Buttons Rule
rules.body: Only buttons and switches are pills. Nodes and chips are clickable too, but keep rectangular corners so they read as objects rather than commands.

rules.name: The Dashed Means Not Yet Rule
rules.body: A dashed stroke marks an empty slot or a bookmark that does not move: the add-folder node, the empty-folder drop zone, the Stays connector (4px dash, 6px gap). It never decorates a filled container.

rules.name: The One Filled Button Rule
rules.body: A screen or dialog has at most one filled button; every other action is tonal, outlined or text.

rules.name: The Weight Is Data Rule
rules.body: A connector's stroke is 1.5px plus 0.5px per bookmark it carries, capped at twelve bookmarks (7.5px). The Stays connector is always 1.5px and dashed.

rules.name: The Draw Once Rule
rules.body: Connectors draw in once per proposal (700ms on the emphasized curve, 40ms stagger per folder, the dashed Stays line fading in); later redraws after an edit or a resize happen without motion.

dos: Do take every color from the role tokens, and give any new surface both its light and its -dark value.
Do keep teal for actions, selection, focus and progress, and amber for To check, New and caution (The Two Signals Rule).
Do fill nodes with node, which resolves to surface-high in dark, so they stay raised over the canvas (The Raised Node Rule).
Do keep the apply toolbar docked as the board's last row, with the trust line visible at every width and the change count on the Apply button.
Do let connector weight carry the count (1.5px plus 0.5px per bookmark, 7.5px at most) and draw connectors in only once per proposal.
Do shrink the favicon preview (three, two, none) before a folder name may truncate.
Do pair every drag gesture with a menu or keyboard path, and light only the folders that can accept the drop.
Do honor reduced motion: connectors and the sheet appear without animation, and unknown progress becomes a static bar.
Do set text in Google Sans at 400 or 500 on the Material type scale.
Do draw icons as inline Material Symbols Rounded SVG: 24px by default, 18px in buttons, chips and segments, 20px in the action bar.
donts: Don't float the apply toolbar over the canvas or move the change count out of the Apply button.
Don't use teal or amber as decoration; apart from the Settings group headings and status line, teal text is always something to press.
Don't lift resting nodes, list cards, the workspace or the docked sheet with a shadow; the notice banner is the one elevated card.
Don't put emoji or Unicode symbols in place of Material Symbols for interface actions and states; emoji belong to folder names.
Don't hide the trust line at any width.
Don't draw connectors or ports in the stacked layout at 760px and below.
Don't replay the connector animation after the first draw.
